cohort: The study included 22 patients who underwent planned laparoscopic cholecystectomy during pregnancy at Western Health in Australia.
finding: Antenatal laparoscopic cholecystectomy demonstrated comparably safe outcomes with no fetal loss or uterine injury and a low rate of major maternal morbidity.
gest_age: Median estimated gestational age at surgery was 19.5 weeks (16.5-23.5); 2 (12%) preterm deliveries occurred.
